items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: Actually, Lee Diamond, uh, wrote along with George Davis, uh, Tell It Like It Is.

ctx.x: Now it gets complicated when you say shareholders. Uh, the, you were, you were in charge of that, the, the Tell It Like It Is, that whole, that recording?

No, no. Uh, who was? Actually, Lee Diamond, uh, wrote along with George Davis, uh, Tell It Like It Is. Uh huh. And, uh, we went into the studio and, uh, you know, uh, we just did the session. I think George Davis, uh, had, uh, a lot to do with Tell It Like It Is, because he was co-writer.
Yeah. He was, he was co-writer, and who, who else, who else do you remember was on that session?
